Where East Meets West

Indi-Yang takes you on a journey from the Far East through to the South of Asia — fish sauce, turmeric, soy, cumin, garam masala and sesame oil, paired in ways that create brand new taste memories.

The kitchen is led by chef and owner Rehan Uddin, founder of the Asian Restaurant Owners Network (ARON). Start with dumplings, follow with a noodle bowl — or a Korean kebab followed by a Bengali-style curry.

Dine in with us on Belgrave Road, or enjoy Indi-Yang at home with takeaway and delivery.
